sourceName: FHWA HPMS 2023, plus PennDOT roadway volumes for the Lancaster region
note: Most places are FHWA HPMS sections with annual average daily traffic and a posted speed. The Lancaster region replaces that sample with PennDOT open data for Lancaster County and the Pennsylvania counties that border it: Lancaster County (36), York County (66), Dauphin County (22), Lebanon County (38), Berks County (06), Chester County (15). Each county uses RMS state-route segments (CUR_AADT) joined to posted speed (roadway admin) and shoulder width in feet (roadway shoulder), plus the Pennsylvania local-road inventory (EST_AVERAGE_DAILY_TRAFFIC, road name, and speed or shoulder when the record includes them). Cecil and Harford counties, Maryland, also border Lancaster and are not in this file. Geometry is simplified. RMS ACCESS_CTRL 1 is limited access.
